title: Establishment and validation of an artificial intelligence-based system for identifying the culprit vessel in patients with ST-segment elevated myocardial infarction: the ALERT study.
summary: An ECG AI system identified culprit vessels in STEMI cases against angiographic reference labels, with internal and external validation and cardiologist comparison.
ai_technology: Methods describe 698 STEMI ECGs, Res-LSTM and angiographic labels; Results report internal/external evaluation and cardiologist comparison.
